sensor.name: CUST - Symantec SEP Client IPS Revision Friendly
sensor.description: Revision of intrusion prevention signatures loaded in SEP but separated in friendly fields so it can be used in parsing or filter.

sensor_query.query:
'================================== ' Symantec Endpoint Protection ' ' Get Client's IPS Revision '==================================
'@INCLUDE=/lib/symantec/IsSepInstalled.vbs
Option Explicit
If IsSepInstalled = "False" Then WScript.Echo "Not Installed" WScript.Quit End If
Const HKLM = &H80000002 Dim oWMISvc : Set oWMISvc = GetObject("winmgmts:\\.\root\cimv2") Dim sArch : sArch = GetArch() Dim oReg : Set oReg = GetRegistryProvider() Dim sSepDefPath : sSepDefPath = GetSepAppDataPath() & "\Definitions" Dim oFSO : Set oFSO = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject") Dim oShell : Set oShell = CreateObject("WScript.Shell")
WScript.Echo GetSepIpsRev()
' Get architecture type Public Function GetArch Dim oCS, qCS : Set qCS = oWMISvc.ExecQuery("Select SystemType from Win32_ComputerSystem") For Each oCS In qCS GetArch = oCS.SystemType Next End Function 'GetArch
' Get registry provider Public Function GetRegistryProvider Dim iArch, oCtx, oLocator, oServices, oRegProv If sArch = "x64-based PC" Then iArch = 64 Else iArch = 32 End If Set oCtx = CreateObject("WbemScripting.SWbemNamedValueSet") oCtx.Add "__ProviderArchitecture", iArch Set oLocator = CreateObject("Wbemscripting.SWbemLocator") Set oServices = oLocator.ConnectServer("","root\default","","",,,,oCtx) Set oRegProv = oServices.Get("StdRegProv")
Set GetRegistryProvider = oRegProv End Function 'GetRegistryProvider
' Get SEP APPDATA path Public Function GetSepAppDataPath Dim sRegPath, sSepAppData If sArch = "x64-based PC" Then sRegPath = "SOFTWARE\Wow6432Node\Symantec\Symantec Endpoint Protection\CurrentVersion\Common Client\PathExpansionMap" Else sRegPath = "SOFTWARE\Symantec\Symantec Endpoint Protection\CurrentVersion\Common Client\PathExpansionMap" End If oReg.GetStringValue HKLM, sRegPath, "AppData", sSepAppData If IsNull(sSepAppData) = True Then WScript.Echo "SepAppDataPath Error" WScript.Quit Else GetSepAppDataPath = sSepAppData End If End Function 'GetSepAppDataPath
' Get SEP IPS Revision Public Function GetSepIpsRev Dim fIpsDefInfo, sIpsDefInfo, RevDate If oFSO.FileExists(sSepDefPath & "\IPSDefs\definfo.dat") Then Set fIpsDefInfo = oFSO.OpenTextFile(sSepDefPath & "\IPSDefs\definfo.dat", 1, False, 0) fIpsDefInfo.SkipLine sIpsDefInfo = Split(fIpsDefInfo.ReadLine(), "=", -1, 1) RevDate=Split(sIpsDefInfo(1),".")
GetSepIpsRev = sIpsDefInfo(1) & "|" & RevDate(1) & "|" & Mid(RevDate(0),7,2)+"/"+Mid(RevDate(0),5,2)+"/"+Mid(RevDate(0),1,4)& "|" & DateDiff("d",Mid(RevDate(0),7,2)+"/"+Mid(RevDate(0),5,2)+"/"+Mid(RevDate(0),1,4),Date) Else GetSepIpsRev = "definfo.dat missing" End If End Function 'GetSepIpsRev '------------ INCLUDES after this line. Do not edit past this point ----- '- Begin file: /lib/symantec/IsSepInstalled.vbs ' Returns True or False if SEP is installed
Function IsSepInstalled Dim colItems : Set colItems = GetObject("winmgmts:\\.\root\cimv2").ExecQuery("Select Status from Win32_Service where Name = 'SepMasterService' or Name = 'Symantec AntiVirus'") If colItems.Count = 0 Then IsSepInstalled = "False" Else IsSepInstalled = "True" End If Set colItems = Nothing End Function 'IsSepInstalled '- End file: /lib/symantec/IsSepInstalled.vbs
